newsitem.title: USA: Funeral set for retired U.S. Justice Brennan.
newsitem.headline: Funeral set for retired U.S. Justice Brennan.

text.p: Funeral services will be held next week for retired Supreme Court Justice William Brennan, a liberal legend and one of the most influential jurists in American history, the high court said Friday.
It said Brennan's body would lie in the great hall of the Supreme Court building across from the U.S. Capitol Monday from 10:30 A.M. to 10 P.M. for public viewing.
Brennan will join the late Supreme Court Justice Thurgood Marshall and former Chief Justices Earl Warren and Warren Burger as the only Supreme Court members who have been given this honour.

Supreme Court spokeswoman Toni House said the funeral will be held at 10 A.M. Tuesday at St. Matthew's Cathedral in Washington, D.C., with burial afterwards at Arlington National Cemetery in nearby Virginia.
Brennan, who had been in failing health, died Thursday at age 91 after a long illness.

Brennan, who retired in 1990 after serving 34 years on the high court, died at a nursing home in Arlington, Virginia, where he had been undergoing rehabilitation for a broken hip suffered in November.
